_comment: Winners of the Emu Cup, a community tournament. `photo` is the file in data_manual/emu_cup_photos/ (<season, 2 digits>-<name>.png, ASCII; not served; may not exist yet), `focus` = [x, y] of the face in the photo (fractions) for the round thumbnail made by scripts/build_emu_cup_thumbs.py, `art` = how scripts/build_victory_column_art.py places the photo on the card (`sign_x` the middle of the face as a fraction of the scaled photo's width, `shift` px the photo starts below its top edge; negative = moves down). Every winner with a photo has a Victory Column card S274_VC_<season>; the newest season is the incumbent champion and also S274_VC (the default): scripts/build_victory_column_art.py (card face), scripts/cardgen/harness/entry.tsx (caption) and web/js/cards.js (roll of honour next to the enlarged Victory Column) read this file.
